name: AcWindowMode
description: Specifies the mode in which a form or report is opened.

constants.name: acWindowNormal
constants.description: (Default) The form or report opens in the mode set by its properties.

constants.name: acHidden
constants.description: The form or report is hidden.

constants.name: acIcon
constants.description: The form or report opens minimized in the Windows taskbar.

constants.name: acDialog
constants.description: The form or report's Modal and PopUp properties are set to Yes.
